from unittest.mock import patch
from chupa import triage
from chupa.driver import Driver
from chupa.git import Git
from chupa.llm import FakeLLM
from chupa.seams import SubprocessExec
from tests.test_daemon_composition import CoreRig, assert_core_wiring
async def main():
    repo = Path.cwd()
    git = Git(SubprocessExec(), env={\"PATH\": \"/usr/bin:/bin\"}, timeout=30)
    base = await git.merge_base(repo, \"main\", \"HEAD\")
    assert await git.rev_parse(repo, \"HEAD\") == base
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == \"\"
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix=\"chupa-serve-custody-\") as directory:
        rig = CoreRig(Path(directory))
        assert_core_wiring(rig)
        constructed = []
        original = Driver.from_config
        def capture(*args, **kwargs):
            driver = original(*args, **kwargs)
            constructed.append(driver)
            return driver
        llm = FakeLLM([])
        with patch.object(Driver, \"from_config\", side_effect=capture):
            assert await triage.triage_pass(rig.checkout, llm) == []
        driver, = constructed
        assert driver.journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is driver.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert llm.requests == [] and rig.exec.calls == []
        print(\"Reproduced on untouched merge base:\", base)
        print(\"triage Driver and Effects use a separate Journal from checkout.journal\")
        print(\"No model or process calls occurred in the synthetic production graph\")
    assert await git.rev_parse(repo, \"HEAD\") == base
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == \"\"
    print(\"Working tree remains clean; no commits created\")
